newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi leads Beirut market.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi leads Beirut market.

text.p: Banque Audi jumped to a new record high of $24 on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday and brokers said it was set to rise further.
Audi rose from $23.25 amid heavy demand that outstripped supply by three times. A bloc of 50,000 Audi shares were also sold in a block trade on the floor at $23.25.
Of the two other bank shares, Bank of Beirut rose to $3.9375 from $3.875 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce fell to $17.875 from $18.
"BLC is still in its consolidation period. It should stabilize at higher levels," a broker said.
The LIBX bank index rose 1.37 percent to 155.06. The LISPI general index rose 0.26 percent to 89.43 while the BLOM general fell 0.73 percent to 922.01.
Market turnover rose to 171,827 shares from 121,565 and value was $2,678,942 from $1,570,764.
Solidere was mixed in strong demand. Solidere B rose to $10.75 from $10.625 while A shares fell to $10.25 from $10.5.
Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125 on turnover of 5,000 shares. There was no trade in the three other industrial companies: Ciment Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
